description: Specify CFD element group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. By default, s is assigned to the group slot Default. Use the remove keyword to remove s from all slots.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot slot to s. By default, slot Default is used.

examples.description: Assign the group in the Default slot

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): element.cfd.isgroup reads True after assignment (Default and named slot) and False after remove on all three consoles - unlike the ball/clump cfd groups, element groups persist on every version.
notes: The manuals list an 'add' keyword (assign s to the next available slot). The engine rejects it with 'Unused extra parameter' on 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8, after it has already assigned s to slot Default. Use 'slot <s2>' to pick another slot.
